author: ojiudezue
title: v5.106.1 shipped: WhatsApp sends via wa_bridge (ha-wa-bridge 3.x)
why: ha-wa-bridge 3.0 renamed its HA domain to wa_bridge and 3.1 made the bridge add-on require an API token that the 2.x integration cannot send, so after the operator updated the add-on the 2.x client got HTTP 401 and NM's hard-coded whatsapp.send_message failed on every alert. A direct wa_bridge.send_message to the operator succeeded, so the fix is choosing the registered domain per send: wa_bridge first, whatsapp fallback, so it works with both installed during the operator's validation window and after 2.x is removed.
implications: Shipped WA-BRIDGE-DOMAIN-1 at v5.106.1; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.106.1.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: NM channel health whatsapp status ok with a non-null last_success after restart, and zero 'WhatsApp send failed' lines in the core log for a day

refs.release_notes: NM sends WhatsApp through wa_bridge.send_message when the 3.x integration is registered, else whatsapp (2.x). Fixes every URA WhatsApp send failing after the bridge add-on began requiring an API token.
